lead: Varun Aaron is a widely followed Indian cricketer, born on 29 October 1989 in Jamshedpur.
As of 2026, he is 36 years old, and his birth date places him under the Scorpio sign.
He has represented Kolkata Knight Riders and India national cricket team.
